<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

 "brief": "## Problem\nWhen the same incident is reported through multiple channels, the Keelwater system creates duplicate claims without warning staff. This splits reserves and confuses adjustments because duplicates go undetected.\n\n## Who is affected\n- **Eight accounts** have raised this issue [i:037d7fd88bdfe192][i:0990586a589ee5d4][i:2b2412a21ba06c15].\n- The problem is reported across **three routes** [i:037d7fd88bdfe192][i:0990586a589ee5d4][i:72656010c210a80e].\n\n## Evidence\n- There have been **16 mentions** of this problem [i:055ee693c115b5fa][i:603ee96296d14553][i:72656010c210a80e].\n- The mentions are distributed by route: **3 from onboarding**, **3 from sales**, and **10 from support** [i:037d7fd88bdfe192][i:0990586a589ee5d4][i:72656010c210a80e].\n- The total Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) from these accounts is **£5,830,000.0**.\n- **Two** of these accounts have renewed in the last 90 days.\n- Pendleford Motor Mutual states, \"when a policyholder reports the same incident both by phone and through the web portal, the system doesn’t alert us — it just creates two separate claims\" [i:037d7fd88bdfe192].\n- Sallowmere Motor reports, \"same incident came in both by phone and through the portal, and now we’ve got two separate claims with no alert to flag it\" [i:0990586a589ee5d4].\n- Callowfield Auto Assurance says, \"we’ve had several instances where the same loss gets reported twice — once by phone, once via web — and the system doesn’t warn us...the system doesn’t show any warning at intake\" [i:2b2412a21ba06c15].\n- Tarnholt Drive Cover explains, \"when a policyholder reports a loss both by phone and through the web portal, the system doesn’t flag it as a potential duplicate... We end up with two separate claims for the same event\" [i:72656010c210a80e]. They also note, \"Right now, we’re manually cross-checking every new claim to avoid the same claim twice\" [i:82e08d8615bf7651].\n- Hollinbrook Home Insurance states, \"We’ve seen the same loss reported through two channels — phone and web — and no system warning appeared\" [i:7572aacb13bfbab0].\n- Orrinbury Fleet Insurance reports, \"we’ve got a situation where a policyholder reported the same incident both over the phone and through the web portal, and it created two separate claims without any alert\" [i:98da20d057061932].\n- Ravensgill Insurance says, \"We’re getting the same claim twice when a policyholder reports via phone and then the portal — no alert pops up at intake\" [i:dadf780eadfacb5e].\n- Brackwater Homecover asks, \"is there a way to lock reporting periods so payments don’t get double‑counted?\" [i:d88340cf245fcbde].\n\n## Why now\n- The issue has been reported consistently from **2026-09-10** to **2026-10-31** [i:d88340cf245fcbde][i:dadf780eadfacb5e][i:e662b0d940a820b4].\n- The high volume of recent support mentions (**10**) indicates the problem is actively causing operational friction [i:72656010c210a80e][i:82e08d8615bf7651][i:8ec45cfe56e665e5].\n- With **two renewals in the last 90 days** and several key accounts representing significant ARR, the issue poses a risk to customer satisfaction and retention.",

<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the headline figures (8 accounts, 16 mentions, 3 routes, route breakdown 3/3/10, ARR £5,830,000.0, two renewals in last 90 days) against the fact sheet and all match exactly. I verified each quotation (Pendleford, Sallowmere, Callowfield, Tarnholt, Hollinbrook, Orrinbury, Ravensgill, Brackwater) against the cited insights and found them verbatim, correctly attributed. The date range 2026-09-10 to 2026-10-31 is supported by the Brackwater and Orrinbury/Ravensgill citations. All cited accounts are drawn from the eight listed, and the 'Why now' claims about support volume and manual cross-checking trace to the Tarnholt and related support insights.", "verdict": "pass"}
